description: This file defines the NotesListActivity class, which is an Android Activity responsible for displaying and managing a list of notes. It handles UI interactions, binds UI components, interacts with the ViewModel to manage state, and responds to user actions such as searching notes, creating new notes, and triggering synchronization.

classes.name: NotesListActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a list of notes, manages user interactions for creating and searching notes, and updates UI based on ViewModel state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, bindings, adapters, and observes ViewModel state to update the UI.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, such as triggering a manual sync.
